🌋🇵🇭 Lava is flowing through three ravines: one of the most active volcanoes has erupted in the Philippines 

The Mayon volcano in the Albay province of the Philippines increased its activity to the third level of danger on May 3rd.

Over the course of a day, 32 volcanic earthquakes were recorded, of which 25 were volcanic tremors lasting from 2 to 15 minutes, as well as 284 landslide signals and 14 signals of pyroclastic flows.

The level of sulfur dioxide emissions is 1586 tons per day.

JOURNALISTS MARK WORLD PRESS FREEDOM DAY WITH PROTEST WALK

Members of the National Union of Journalists of the Philippines (NUJP) and Altermidya held a walk for freedom around the Academic Oval of the University of the Philippines in Diliman, Quezon City on Sunday, May 3, 2026, to mark World Press Freedom Day.

The groups called for justice for slain activist journalist Rj Ledesma and the release of detained journalist Frenchie Mae Cumpio.

📸 The STAR/Miguel de Guzman

Combat Team Jackal, comprising personnel from the @AustralianArmy 🇦🇺 and the @NZDefenceForce 🇳🇿, participated in live-fire rehearsals during Exercise Balikatan 2026.

Exercise Balikatan 2026 (BK26) is an annual training exercise conducted between the Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) and United States military designed to enhance military cooperation and readiness.
